name: The An-Xileel
notes: The nativist successor administration that governs Argonia in 4E 201 — offices and name inherited from the movement of 4E 6, mandate not.
standing_join_refusal: The state's own administration; it recognises and employs people but offers no ranks to a newcomer (quests/10 political frame).

name: The Blackguards
notes: Argonian pirate-brigand company operating out of the southern coast.
standing_join_refusal: A prison-born heritage community; its heirs live at Blackrose and are implicated, not recruiting (40-factions §39).

name: Bright-Throat tribe
notes: Murkmire tribe; horse-lizard breeders, welcoming to outsiders by local standards.
standing_join_refusal: A tribe takes its people from its own Hist's clutches; a stranger earns a hearing, not a rank.

name: Blackrose Chainbreakers
notes: Abolitionists auditing and burning the Owing; quest line BC01-BC06.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Never-Sold, the auditing patron above a boat-shed in Blackrose city

name: College of Whispers
notes: Fourth-Era successor to the Mages Guild; discreet, interested in Hist and Umbriel leavings.
standing_join_refusal: A foreign necromantic body that works through intermediaries; the Sunken Archive line meets it at SA04 and Argonians refuse it on principle (40-factions §34).

name: Cyrodilic Collections
notes: Antiquities society working Murkmire; licences, digs and repatriation arguments.
standing_join_refusal: A foreign antiquities society that licenses digs; it hires, it does not enrol.

name: House Dres remnant
notes: The slaving house's surviving northern interests and claimants after abolition.
standing_join_refusal: The slaving interests the Chainbreakers oppose; no player joins them.

name: Imperial Legion remnant
notes: Left-behind Legion garrisons and their descendants on the Blackwood and Gideon frontier; no longer paid by Cyrodiil.
standing_join_refusal: A remnant of a defunct authority; no chain of command is left to take a recruit.

name: The League of Open Water
notes: Citizenship and property argued on the water; quest line LW01-LW10.

name: The Many-Root Conclave
notes: Hist stewardship, consent and ecology; quest line MR01-MR10.
standing_join_sponsor_role: the village Tree-Minder, who sponsors a Helper (Root-Herald Ixo-Vaal and Sap-Speaker Kaska-Meen sit the council)

name: The Marsh Charter
notes: Fighters'-guild tradition set against a foreign charter; quest line FG01-FG10.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Halvar the Damp, the Charter's hiring floor at Alten Corimont (the frontier-fort captain and Ka-Deelith Ushu are the other desks)

name: Morrowind veterans
notes: Dunmer soldiers of the accession fighting who never went home.
standing_join_refusal: Veterans of a war that ended; a holding, not an enrolling body.

name: Murkwater tribe
notes: Murkmire tribe; hunters and trainers.
standing_join_refusal: A tribe takes its people from its own Hist's clutches; a stranger earns a hearing, not a rank.

name: The Naga-Kur
notes: The deep-marsh Naga polity of the southern basin.
standing_join_refusal: A tribe takes its people from its own Hist's clutches; a stranger earns a hearing, not a rank.

name: Night-Reed Chapter
notes: The province's thieves' guild; quest line TG01-TG11, escalating to the Tidal Palace heist.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Deep-In-Her-Cups, who runs the Soulrest den (Vasha and Sails-By-Morning are the other desks)

name: Nisswo of the Turning Path
notes: Priests of Sithis; plural belief against dogma. Quest line NI01-NI10.
standing_join_sponsor_role: the silent Nisswo of NI02, who takes a newcomer through the six-stop day

name: The Reed-Sail Compact
notes: Boat crews, routes, labour and monopoly; quest line RS01-RS10, with the Salt-Teeth pirate branch inside it.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Route-Keeper Sesha-Ku, who runs the Compact hall

name: Root-Whisper tribe
notes: Tribe whose Hist withdrew after the Knahaten Flu; the village and the dreaming tree.
standing_join_refusal: A tribe takes its people from its own Hist's clutches; a stranger earns a hearing, not a rank.

name: Rootworm Waykeepers
notes: Keepers of the sacred rootworm transit routes; quest line RW01-RW05. The worm is never on screen.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Handler Ki-Ossa, who keeps the Helstrom terminus (Tuxo keeps the hidden station)

name: The Salt-Teeth
notes: Pirate confederation; the Reed-Sail line's pirate branch (ST01-ST04) rather than a separate line.
standing_join_refusal: A pirate branch inside the Reed-Sail Compact, not a separate line (40-factions §43); a newcomer enters it by the Compact's outlaw path after RS05, never by joining here.

name: The Empty Cradle — Shadowscales
notes: Sithis-dedicated assassin order with three bidders and no issuing authority; quest line SS01-SS10.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Ohl-Katta, the Black-Tongue deelith whose tradition desk trains the Shadow-born; the Veiled Reed's chartering officer and Rasha are the rival bidders

name: Stillrise Village
notes: The undead village of Shadowfen, kept standing by its array.
standing_join_refusal: A settlement; its people are residents, not a membership.

name: The Sul-Xan
notes: Soul-taking Argonian tribe; hostile presence in the deep interior.
standing_join_refusal: Naga cultists of Dagon who embrace only the cruellest beliefs; they offer no seat to an outsider (40-factions NI05).

name: The Sunken Archive
notes: Mages'-guild-shaped scholarly order contesting the ownership of knowledge; quest line SA01-SA10.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Xul-Nasha, who keeps the wet-and-dry collection rooms

name: The Synod
notes: The College of Whispers' rival successor order; publicly chartered, politically ambitious.
standing_join_refusal: A foreign body with no presence in the province; the Sunken Archive line meets it at SA05 and its Umbriel history is a standing Argonian refusal (40-factions §34).

name: Thorn Ash-Reed Accord
notes: Border memory and saltrice title on the Morrowind frontier; quest line TA01-TA05.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Vicecanon Neetra-Sei, the magistrate who holds her meetings on a boat

name: Tribeless Naga
notes: Naga outside the Naga-Kur's protection or discipline; the deeps' unaligned danger.
standing_join_refusal: Outcasts with no tribe to keep a roll; there is no body to join.

name: Umbriel Witness Society
notes: Inherited catastrophe, argued over; quest line UW01-UW05.
standing_join_sponsor_role: Keeps-The-Count, who keeps the Society's Lilmoth archive room

name: The Unbound Root
notes: Hist-supremacist antagonist movement of the main quest; genuine victims of state abuse alongside fanatics and infiltrators.
standing_join_refusal: A main-quest alignment, not a completionist line (40-factions §30); the ending decides it, never a joining.

name: Unclaimed
notes: Sentinel value: the place has no holder. Not a group; never used as a quest gate.

name: The Veiled Reed
notes: Project-original covert intelligence and internal-security office of the An-Xileel state; the main quest's handler structure.
standing_join_refusal: The state's covert office and a main-quest alignment, not a completionist line; it recognises the newcomer and offers one route, never membership (40-factions §30).

name: Xit-Xaht
notes: Murkmire tribe of Vakka-Bur; Hist-driven and feared.
standing_join_refusal: A tribe takes its people from its own Hist's clutches; a stranger earns a hearing, not a rank.
